─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Permissions

  Selections are saved as your default for new sessions and exec runs.

  1. Read only              Reads files only.
  2. Ask me                 Edits workspace and temporary files; requires approval for protected writes, new network targets, and
                            other restricted actions.
⟩ 3. Auto-review (current)  Same access as Ask me; AI reviews eligible actions; trusted permission hooks may decide approval
                            requests first.
  4. Unrestricted           No filesystem sandbox or approval prompts; local commands have direct network access; project trust
                            is unchanged.
